devoirs.titre: Devoir de Contrôle N°2 — Reading, Grammar & Guided Writing

exercices.titre: Language: Put the bracketed words in the right tense or form
exercices.enonce:
1. If Tunisian students (organize) __________ their revision earlier, they will feel much more confident.
2. Renewable energy plays an (increase) __________ important role in Tunisia's economy.
3. By the end of June, the candidates (complete) __________ all their national exams.
4. She succeeded thanks to her (determine) __________ and daily discipline.
exercices.corrige:
1. organize (Type 1 conditional: Present Simple + will).
2. increasingly (Adverb modifying adjective 'important').
3. will have completed (Future Perfect triggered by 'By the end of June').
4. determination (Noun after possessive 'her').

exercices.enonce: Topic: Write a short article giving three practical tips to help 3rd-year high school students balance exam preparation and healthy habits.
exercices.corrige:
Scoring criteria:
- Adherence to task & format (title + 3 clear tips: active recall, 45-min study blocks, 8h sleep) : 4 pts.
- Language accuracy & connectors (First, Furthermore, Finally) : 4 pts.
- Mechanics (spelling, capitalization, punctuation) : 2 pts.

devoirs.titre: Devoir de Synthèse N°1 — Language & Guided Essay (Bac Sciences)

exercices.titre: Language: Put the bracketed words in the right tense or form
exercices.enonce:
Put the bracketed words in the correct tense or form:
1. Over the last decade, solar energy projects (expand) __________ rapidly across southern Tunisia.
2. Scientific research should be funded to promote (sustain) __________ development.
3. Thousands of young engineers (recruit) __________ by tech startups every year.
4. Without continuous (innovate) __________, companies struggle to stay competitive.
5. She wishes she (apply) __________ for the Mediterranean science scholarship earlier.
exercices.corrige:
1. have been expanding / have expanded (Present Perfect Continuous or Present Perfect triggered by 'Over the last decade').
2. sustainable (Adjective modifying the noun 'development').
3. are recruited (Present Simple Passive: routine action with 'every year' and agent 'by tech startups').
4. innovation (Noun after adjective 'continuous').
5. had applied (Past regret after 'wishes' + 'earlier' → Past Perfect).

exercices.titre: Writing: Argumentative Essay (12 lines — Bac Format)
exercices.enonce: Topic: Many talented young graduates leave Tunisia to work abroad (brain drain), while others choose to build startups and contribute locally. Write a 12-line essay discussing the main reasons behind this trend and suggesting two concrete solutions to encourage young talents to stay or return.
exercices.corrige:
Official Bac English Marking Scale (10 pts):
- Adherence to task & content adequacy (4 pts): Clear intro defining brain drain, 2 causes (higher salaries, research facilities) + 2 realistic solutions (startup incentives, remote global jobs, better R&D labs).
- Lexical appropriacy & grammar accuracy (4 pts): Accurate tenses, linking words (Whereas, Consequently, Moreover, To address this issue).
- Mechanical accuracy (2 pts): Spelling, punctuation, capitalization, and clear paragraphing.
